neighbours.label: a small set of built-environment / industry nouns as tokens: ' buildings', ' building', ' materials', ' structure', ' production', ' equipment' (also ' trucks'). Not a general 'man-made things' feature: ' houses', ' machines', ' tools', ' vans' stay quiet.
fire: Most of the buildings on the square date from the 1890s.
The storm damaged several buildings along the waterfront.
The school ordered new materials for the art room.
Builders prefer local materials when the budget is tight.
The tower is a slender structure of brick and iron.
Milk production fell sharply during the dry summer.
The gym replaced its old equipment over the holidays.
The hospital bought new equipment for the laboratory.
quiet: Most of the houses on the square date from the 1890s.
The storm damaged several boats along the waterfront.
The school ordered new books for the art room.
Gardeners prefer local plants when the budget is tight.
The workshop is full of machines and hand tools.
Milk prices fell sharply during the dry summer.
The gym replaced its old towels over the holidays.
Two vans and a bus were waiting at the gate.

notes: Layer 1, so tested as bare tokens. Card: ' buildings' x5, ' building' x5, 'ular' x4 (tubular), ' trucks' x4. Probes: ' buildings' 0.50, ' materials' 0.57, ' structure' 0.62, ' production' 0.51, ' equipment' 0.44, ' trucks' 0.31, ' building' 0.18; ' houses' 0.03, ' machines' 0.00, ' vans' 0.08, ' cars' 0.20. This is a list, and I could not find the pattern behind it: 'machines' and 'tools' being silent rules out 'manufactured things'. The token after 'tubular' also read high (' shape' 0.68, ' frame' 0.50), which the label does not cover.
